messages.subject: Importing Figtree with branch colorings
parts:
Aloha, 
I am trying to import into R the paintings of branches of a phylogenetic tree.  It is easy to paint them by hand in FigTree, and I thought I could read in the metadata as "label", however, I canʻt figure out the syntax specification in read.newick. I also tried to search and replace the FigTree .tre file but I donʻt know what the expected format is for the label and the characterstring:

In FigTree, the color is specified as:
&!color=#000000
Such as: 
(taxa1[&!color=#000000]:6.153874,taxa2[&!color=#000000]:6.153874) 

I tried specifying node.label="&!color"
And replacing &!color in the file with "label"=, or &label=, putting quotes around the color hex codes etc. But I always get the error:

Error in if (all(phy$node.label == "")) phy$node.label <- NULL : 
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

I think this must be a simple thing. Thank you for your help. Here is the FigTree files that produce the error with these lines:

require(treeio)
read.newick("Two_regime.tre", node.label="&!color")
read.newick("Four_regime2.tre", node.label="label")

Thank you for your help!
Marguerite
